title: Poll
description: A question with no right answer, where the point is seeing how everyone answered.
demoHtml:
<quick-poll question="When a layout breaks, what do you do first?">
  <input value="Open DevTools"><input value="Rewrite the CSS"><input value="Ask a classmate"><input value="Search the error">
</quick-poll>

attributes.name: typeof
attributes.description: OER Schema type. Reflected so it is also in server rendered HTML.

attributes.name: question
attributes.description: The question, shown as the title of the block.

attributes.name: options
attributes.description: The options, [{ label }]. Read from and written to the light DOM `<input value="...">` children.

attributes.name: show-results
attributes.description: When the learner sees results: "after" (after voting), "closed" (after the closes date-time passes) or "never" (instructor only).

attributes.name: closes
attributes.description: Date-time the poll closes (anything Date.parse reads, e.g. 2026-12-01T17:00). Voting stops then.

attributes.name: allow-change
attributes.description: Let the learner change their vote in the same visit.

attributes.name: endpoint
attributes.description: Optional http(s) address that counts votes. POST { activityId, choice } on vote, GET ?activityId=... on load; both answer { counts: { <optionId>: <number> } }.

attributes.name: accent-color
attributes.description: Optional accent for the chip, markers and Vote button, using the accent-color names DDD maps (see DDDAccent.js).

gizmo.title: Poll
gizmo.description: A question with no right answer, where the point is seeing how everyone answered.

configure.title: Question
configure.description: What everyone is asked. There is no right answer.

configure.title: Options
configure.description: The choices to vote on. Add at least two.

configure.title: Results show
configure.description: When a learner sees how everyone voted.

advanced.title: Closes
advanced.description: Date and time voting stops. Leave empty for a poll that stays open.

advanced.title: Allow changing a vote
advanced.description: Let a learner change their vote during the same visit.

advanced.title: Results address
advanced.description: Optional web address (http or https) that counts votes and answers with the totals. Leave empty when a plugin supplies results or none are shown.
